meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd probably start by, yeah, just understanding a bit on your current situation and how we can help.
rapport_topics: Lead's 20+ years as a property developer
Where Stayful is based (Leicestershire + Leeds, nationwide cover)
Whether Stayful covers Knutsford / Manchester / Stockport
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Well, what I suppose I could do then is I can just talk you through, through the figures.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we're looking at gross revenue ... about £98,000 per year. Now the net of that, which is what you'll get as a payout, is about £51,000 a year, so about £4,200 a month.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: Yeah, you'll get a calendar, you can see all the bookings that come in, you'll get a communications app as well so we can talk to each other
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: If you're wanting to come on board, I'll send you over our agreement, our management agreement. If you sign that, send it back to me. Then we can probably get the property live from the sounds of it in the next sort of 2 weeks
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I mean, is there any, any concerns you've got about coming on board? Anything we can go through, or you're sort of happy?
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: When I send you that email, if you want to come back with that, the full address and postcode of the [Stockport] property and the number of bedrooms, I can run the report ... and we can have another chat about it if you want.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Is that will be exclusive of bills? ... What about the cleaning side?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Yes, exclusive of the bills ... it's after the cleaning.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Okay, yeah, so that's only bills for the property, for like gas, electric, maybe water, and the council tax, Wi-Fi

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What's the percentage of your long-term contractor from your website? You say 40-something, 45%, you take direct booking?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Once the property is established with good reviews you can expect anywhere between 20% and 40% direct bookings, driven by contractors, build projects, hospitals and transport links nearby.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: This property is quite close to the airport ... 10 or 12 minutes.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I thought maybe you don't charge for photography. That's the same setup fee. There's no setup fee. I thought maybe it's all included in that.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: We don't charge for our own internal setup work; photos (~£250-£350) and deep cleans are invoiced straight from the supplier with no markup — and because you paid for them, the photos belong to you if you ever switch operator or self-manage.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Raised again twice more before the end of the call ('you need to throw in this with the setup, everything should be free' / 'photographs will be free, I'm telling you')

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Then you need a 1-month notice to vacate ... But if we don't perform well, then what's going to happen? ... if with 2 months there's not much booking days, I have to be losing money
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 6-month fixed term then 3-month notice (so future guests can be serviced); case studies land within 5-10% of projection; at ~£4,200 net against ~£2,000 mortgage + bills, even 20% below projection is still profitable.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: No, that's fine. I'm not bothered with that ... I'm just saying possibility there.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: 15% will be on the net or on the gross? ... So normally people charge 15% on the net.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 15% + VAT on the gross, after booking platform commissions but before everything else — the three costs in gross-to-net are platform commission (~15%), management (15%) and cleaning/laundry (~18%, guest-paid).
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I don't know to be — I didn't look into that side.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: The other platform you use like Booking or Airbnb, they charge 15% or 16%?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: They all charge around 15%; Airbnb has recently gone up.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Right, okay, if I go ahead with yourself, well, I will get the app.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I just need to check your website ... I think you're quite good review. You got maybe 4.8
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: I can send you links to our Airbnb account and Google reviews, plus the case studies I mentioned.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, so tell me that will be good.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I've got another house which is nearly ready, in Stockport ... How about Blackpool side? ... we got hotel there ... 26-bedroom hotel
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Email the full address, postcode and bedroom count and I'll run the report; happy to look at the Blackpool en-suite hotel too (very seasonal).

What 'no setup fee' covers — specifically photography
Downside if bookings are slow in the first months and how to exit

A concession that makes the trial feel free to start (photography)
Proof via reviews/case studies before scaling to Stockport, Blackpool and Manchester

Being unable to show figures on a phone call
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: Unlike prior R2R leads (thin-margin, often lost), this is an experienced operator with a strong margin and a ready property — treat as a trial-to-portfolio opportunity: settle small concessions (photography) decisively on the call, confirm R2R owner consent/insurance, and get agreement signed quickly because the upside is the follow-on properties
